name: Centro Storico
description: The atmospheric old town gathers around Piazza IV Novembre, the Fontana Maggiore and the grand Corso Vannucci, with the National Gallery of Umbria, cathedral and stone lanes at every turn. It is walkable, historic and endlessly photogenic.
bestFor: Culture lovers wanting atmosphere, cafes and sights on their doorstep

name: Porta Sole and Universita per Stranieri
tagline: International student quarter near the centre
description: Perched on one of the city's highest points beside the University for Foreigners, this area buzzes with international students learning Italian. Expect language schools, budget eateries, viewpoints and an easy stroll down into the main historic core.
bestFor: Language learners and students wanting an international, sociable base

name: Elce
tagline: Leafy residential district north of centre
description: A calm, mainly residential neighbourhood favoured by families, staff and students linked to the University of Perugia. Elce offers everyday shops, greener streets and steadier rents, while staying close enough to reach the historic centre without much effort.
bestFor: Nomads wanting calm, affordable local life near the university

name: Fontivegge
tagline: Modern lower town by the station
description: The practical lower town around Fontivegge holds the main train station, the Minimetro link up to the old centre and more modern, functional buildings. It is well connected for regional travel, with everyday services, offices and reasonable prices.
bestFor: Frequent travellers valuing transport links and lower rents
cons: Less charm than the old town
